items.detail: Ran the exact proof command: exit_code 0, output "1 passed in 0.15s". The test is not skipped: the full-file run with -rs printed "9 passed" with no skip summary, and the skip guard cannot fire because tempfile.gettempdir() is /var/tmp/hermes-scratch and `git -C /tmp rev-parse --show-toplevel` returns "fatal: not a git repository".
